headline: Our favorite headphones and earbuds are cheaper during October Prime Day
summary: Top-rated headphones and earbuds are on sale during October Prime Day. Many popular options are at or near their lowest-ever prices. Deals are available on Amazon (some requiring Prime) and other retailers.

headline: We can’t just change the definition of ‘recording’
summary: Tech companies are blurring the lines of what constitutes a 'recording' with AI hardware. Traditionally, a device with a mic/camera was clearly either recording or not. New technologies create a grey area, challenging established definitions.

headline: HBO Max and Paramount Plus will merge into a single streamer under Skydance
summary: HBO Max and Paramount Plus are set to combine into one streaming service. The merger follows Paramount's $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery by Skydance. The unified service will be rolled out over time under the Skydance umbrella.

headline: The stylish Nothing Headphone 1 are cheaper than ever
summary: The stylish Nothing Headphone 1 are currently on sale for $189 on Amazon. This represents a significant discount from their usual price range ($240-$299). The headphones offer a unique design and great sound quality.

headline: Reebok Reveals Avatar: The Last Airbender Collection With 4 New Sneaker Designs
summary: Reebok has unveiled a new sneaker collection inspired by Avatar: The Last Airbender. The collection features four distinct new sneaker designs. It pays homage to the beloved cartoon series.

headline: Michael Bay in Talks to Direct Next Transformers Film, Steven Spielberg Returning as Key Creative Producer
summary: Michael Bay is reportedly in early talks to direct the next Transformers movie. Steven Spielberg is set to return as a key creative producer. This follows a successful meeting between Bay and Spielberg.

headline: State of Decay 3 Was Revealed Early Partly Because of the Studio Boss' Anxiety Around Xbox's Plans
summary: Undead Labs boss Philip Holt explained the early announcement of State of Decay 3. The decision was partly driven by anxiety over Xbox's future plans. Holt wanted to secure the studio's vision amidst platform uncertainty.

headline: Sonos Is Hosting Its Own Prime Day Sale With Up to 25% Off Soundbars, Subs and Speakers
summary: Sonos is currently holding its own Prime Day-style sale event. Customers can get up to 25% off soundbars, subwoofers, and speakers. This sale offers early discounts ahead of Black Friday.

headline: Watch: At the scene of student protests in Lille
summary: The BBC's Europe correspondent reports live from Lille, France. Large student demonstrations are currently taking place in the city. The report provides a direct view of the protest action.

headline: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident
summary: A British national has been arrested regarding an incident near RAF Fairford. This marks the seventh arrest related to last month's event. Investigations into the RAF Fairford incident are ongoing.

headline: I'd rather have another election than do a deal with Reform UK, says Badenoch
summary: Kemi Badenoch states she prefers a new election over a deal with Reform UK. The Conservative Party leader also pledged to reduce the cost of hiring young adults. This stance reflects internal party strategy and economic proposals.

headline: PCs who used Taser and baton on amputee, 92, sacked
summary: Two police constables have been sacked for using excessive force. They used a Taser and baton on a 92-year-old amputee at his care home. A disciplinary hearing found their actions constituted unnecessary force.
